spillover_shadow: Same primary player state, injury minute redistribution disabled; descriptive until fixed review
low_role_shadow: Legacy cap2 heuristic is a separate uncalibrated alternative. Primary policy unchanged; no probability weights or automatic adoption.
rotation_comparison: Primary uses the separately validated active rotation policy. rotation_untuned keeps fraction1 and no evidence attenuation; cap2 also uses that fixed untuned policy. Aliases avoid duplicate rows.
target: Per-player conditional minutes and category production; availability separately
evaluation: Use earliest recorded prediction per player-game-horizon; do not count repeated runs as independent samples
horizon: Next calendar day in America/New_York; same-day games excluded until exact tipoff timestamps are available
star_definition: Projected prior MPG >=25, fixed from completed-season prior at forecast time

promotion.reviews: Single preregistered review; no daily significance peeking; no automatic promotion or rollback

interpretation: No randomized add/drop control: forecasting accuracy does not establish causal gains in won categories
